lines.cap: People say Stanley Kubrick faked the Moon landing. But Kubrick was such a perfectionist, he'd have shot it on location.

lines.cap: 1969. Six hundred million people watch Apollo Eleven land. A few years later, a book claimed it was all fake.

lines.cap: The flag waves, so there's wind! Actually, a rod holds it out. It only moved while they twisted the pole in.

lines.cap: No stars in the sky! Because the ground was bright sunlight. Your phone can't catch stars in daylight either.

lines.cap: Here's the proof you can check. Apollo astronauts left mirrors on the Moon. Scientists still bounce lasers off them today.

lines.cap: And four hundred thousand people worked on Apollo. Not one leaked. Most of us can't keep a group chat secret.
